passage.text_en:
Dear Residents,

Due to emergency pipe repairs in the basement, water service will be temporarily shut off on Sunday, March 12th, from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

Please store enough water for drinking and basic needs before the shut-off. Service will resume promptly after repairs are completed.

For urgent questions on Sunday, call the building manager at ext. 205. For non-urgent matters, please wait until Monday business hours.

We apologize for the inconvenience.
— Building Management
